_about: Examples of shortcuts: launch intents that act like an app rather than a system. Never read as config.
To use one, copy it into shortcuts.json (same key) and place it in directory.json, e.g. { "shortcut": "settings-wifi" }.
Each takes a "name" for the menu plus a launch intent (see CONFIG.md). Without an "action" it opens like a home screen icon.
A shortcut takes no game, so data kinds and extras that pass the game file (file_provider, path, uri_string...) don't apply.
To open a URI, use data kind custom_scheme: the URI is scheme://authority.

settings-wifi._note: An action on its own: Android's Wi-Fi settings.
settings-wifi.name: Wi-Fi

cannoli-notifications._note: A named activity with a fixed extra: this app's notification settings.
cannoli-notifications.name: Cannoli Notifications

web-manual._note: VIEW of a web page in a browser. The URI is https://<authority>.
web-manual.name: RetroArch Docs

kodi-movies._note: VIEW with an app's own scheme: opens a Kodi add-on.
kodi-movies.name: Movies
